transcript.text: Hello everyone. I'm Mina, the bicycle mechanic here. I understand Rafael wants to discuss some maintenance work on his cargo e-bike through an informal exchange. Before we go any further, I want to be clear about my usual practice here at the workshop: I'll need the requester — that's you, Rafael — to state your complete proposed exchange and appointment out loud. I'll also need whoever inspected the bike to state their technical findings out loud. Once I've heard both statements and recorded them, I'll make my decision about whether to accept the exchange. So, whenever you're ready, go ahead and lay out your full proposal.

transcript.text: My proposal is for Mina to tune the cargo e-bike's gears and brakes, in exchange for my working 9-tray food dehydrator with no cash involved. I can bring the bike on Saturday at 10:00.
